title: Managed tables in Lakeflow pipelines (Beta)
body:
You can now create managed tables in Lakeflow pipelines and write to them with one or more append flows. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). You can also use `import_checkpoint` on an append flow to migrate an existing Structured Streaming workload into a pipeline without reprocessing the source.

See [create\_table](/aws/en/ldp/developer/ldp-python-ref-create-table), [CREATE TABLE ... FLOW (pipelines)](/aws/en/ldp/developer/ldp-sql-ref-create-table-flow), and [append\_flow](/aws/en/ldp/developer/ldp-python-ref-append-flow).
